# Skills, slash commands and output styles

Where these methods are:

- `session.skills` — `Session.skills`, a `SessionSkills`
- `session` — on `Session` itself

Every method here is generated from igni-core's RPC contract; its documentation is igni's own. The examples run inside an `async` function with `igni` an open `IgniClient` and `session` one of its sessions ([Quick start](/docs/sdk/igni-client/quick-start)).

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`session.skills.definitions()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/skills-and-commands#session-skills-definitions) | List this session's skills with what each tells the agent. |
| [`session.skills.list()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/skills-and-commands#session-skills-list) | Describe each of this session's skills in full. |
| [`session.skills.names()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/skills-and-commands#session-skills-names) | List the names of the skills this session has loaded. |
| [`session.command()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/skills-and-commands#session-command) | Run a slash command in this session, as typed in igni's composer: `/help`, `/compact`, `/model`. |
| [`session.slash_commands()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/skills-and-commands#session-slash-commands) | List every slash command this session takes. |
| [`session.output_styles()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/skills-and-commands#session-output-styles) | List the output styles this session can answer in, and the active one. |

## session.skills.definitions()

List this session's skills with what each tells the agent.

```python
async def definitions(self) -> list[SkillDefinition]
```

Takes no arguments. Returns each skill's `name`, `description`
and `prompt` (the skill's body).

Takes no arguments.

**Returns** `list[`[`SkillDefinition`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#skilldefinition)`]`.

**How long** `instant` — Answered from what igni holds in memory, at once.
The client waits up to 10 seconds.

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `get_skill_definitions`, scope `session`, area `skills`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
for skill_definition in await session.skills.definitions():
    print(skill_definition.name, skill_definition.description)
```

## session.skills.list()

Describe each of this session's skills in full.

```python
async def list(self) -> list[SkillInfo]
```

Takes no arguments. Returns each skill's name, description,
version, category, argument hint, the context and agent it runs
in, whether a person can invoke it, its body and its folder.

Takes no arguments.

**Returns** `list[`[`SkillInfo`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#skillinfo)`]`.

**How long** `instant` — Answered from what igni holds in memory, at once.
The client waits up to 10 seconds.

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `get_skill_details`, scope `session`, area `skills`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
for skill_info in await session.skills.list():
    print(skill_info.name, skill_info.agent)
```

## session.command()

Run a slash command in this session, as typed in igni's composer: `/help`, `/compact`, `/model`.

```python
async def command(self, text: str = '') -> CommandResult
```

`text` is the command line, its leading `/` optional. Returns igni's `command_result`: its `kind` (`markdown`, `info`, `error` or `action`), the `content` to show and the `action` the command asks a client to take. The commands that switch approvals off, change what igni loads or whom it signs in to (`/bypass`, `/accept`, `/plugin`, `/eject`, `/login`, `/logout`) answer an `error` to anything but igni's window.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `str` | `''` | The command as typed, slash included, e.g. `/help`. |

**Returns** [`CommandResult`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/events-reference#commandresult).

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** the message `command`, answered by igni's `command_result`.

**Example**

```python
result = await session.command("/help")
print(result.kind, result.content)
```

## session.slash_commands()

List every slash command this session takes.

```python
async def slash_commands(self) -> list[SlashCommand]
```

Takes no arguments. Returns igni's built-in commands, commands
written as markdown files, skills a person can invoke, and
extensions' commands, told apart by `source`; each with its
`name`, `description` and `argument_hint`.

Takes no arguments.

**Returns** `list[`[`SlashCommand`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#slashcommand)`]`.

**How long** `instant` — Answered from what igni holds in memory, at once.
The client waits up to 10 seconds.

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `get_slash_commands`, scope `session`, area `panels`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
print(await session.slash_commands())
```

## session.output_styles()

List the output styles this session can answer in, and the active one.

```python
async def output_styles(self) -> OutputStylesResult
```

Takes no arguments. Returns the `active` style's name (empty for
none) and every style's `name` and `description`.

Takes no arguments.

**Returns** [`OutputStylesResult`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#outputstylesresult).

**How long** `instant` — Answered from what igni holds in memory, at once.
The client waits up to 10 seconds.

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `get_output_styles`, scope `session`, area `panels`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
output_styles = await session.output_styles()
print(output_styles.active, output_styles.styles)
```
